verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is a cloud SaaS that holds user data such as profiles and recordings, so the export-and-leave axis applies. The evidence is only indirect: session recordings come in open formats (rrweb DOM recordings and MP4). Lock-in is also reduced because sessions use standard Playwright/Puppeteer/CDP endpoints and HyperAgent is open-source. Missing for 10: any documented account-wide data export, export of saved profiles (cookies, storage) or usage history, a stated data-portability or deletion process, and independent corroboration that users can retrieve their data.
